title: Fantaisie-Pastorale
identity: Ethos Publications identifies Jules Demersseman’s Fantaisie-Pastorale, Op.56, as an original soprano saxophone and piano work, in C with saxophone in D, about four minutes. Its description outlines an Andante opening and return, quicker moderately difficult passages, a short cadenza and a closing flourish. Two commercial recordings are listed, including Ronald Caravan’s 2017 recording.
